JavaScript

Interactive components use plain data attributes and a runtime of about 300 lines with no dependencies. It works on any HTML: server-rendered pages, htmx swaps, or markup rendered by a client framework.

Loading

Every behavior is an ES module that imports ./velle.js and starts working as soon as it loads. Include the behaviors you use:

<script type="module" src="/assets/js/velle/dialog.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="/assets/js/velle/tabs.js"></script>

Or load the bundle, which contains the runtime and every behavior:

<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/codedbyshoe/velle-css@v{{.Site.Version}}/dist/velle.js"></script>

The bundle leaves out the adapters. To use one with the bundle, load it from dist/adapters/, next to dist/velle.js; those copies import ../velle.js and share its runtime.

Elements are set up when the page loads and whenever matching markup is added later. A MutationObserver watches the document, so nothing needs to be re-initialized after content changes.

Attributes

Each behavior has a name, such as tabs or check-all, and reads these attributes:

AttributePurposeExample
data-NAMEMarks the root element. Each root gets its own controller instance.<div data-tabs>
data-NAME-targetNames an element inside the root that the behavior uses. Several names can be separated by spaces.data-tabs-target="button"
data-NAME-actionConnects events to the behavior's actions. Can sit on the root or anything inside it.data-tabs-action="select"
data-NAME-OPTIONAn option read from the root.data-tabs-index="2"
data-NAME-PARAM-paramA value passed to an action as event.params.PARAM.data-form-submitter-param="save"

Roots can be nested. A target or action always belongs to the closest root with the same name.

Action syntax

[event[.keyfilter][@document|@window]->]action[:prevent][:stop][:self]
PartMeaning
eventAny DOM event name, including custom events. When omitted, the element's default event is used: click for buttons and links, input for inputs and textareas (click for submit inputs), change for selects, submit for forms and toggle for <details>.
.keyfilterFor keydown, keyup and keypress: only run for this key. Keys: a–z, 0–9, enter, tab, esc, space, up, down, left, right, home, end, page_up, page_down. Prefix with ctrl+, meta+, alt+ or shift+; modifiers must match exactly.
@document, @windowListen on the document or window instead of the element, e.g. for keyboard shortcuts and outside clicks.
:preventCalls event.preventDefault() before the action.
:stopCalls event.stopPropagation() before the action.
:selfOnly runs when the event's target is the element itself, not a descendant.

Separate several actions with spaces:

<textarea data-form-action="keydown.ctrl+enter->submit keydown.meta+enter->submit"></textarea>

Events

Behaviors announce changes with bubbling CustomEvents named velle:NAME:EVENT, dispatched from the root element. Each component page lists its events.

document.addEventListener("velle:tabs:change", event => {
  console.log("Selected tab", event.detail.index)
})

Writing your own behavior

The runtime exports what the built-in behaviors use, so your own code can follow the same conventions:

import { define, Controller } from "./velle.js"

// <div data-counter data-counter-start="5">
//   <output data-counter-target="count"></output>
//   <button data-counter-action="increment">+1</button>
// </div>
define("counter", class extends Controller {
  #count = 0

  connect() {
    this.#count = Number(this.data("start")) || 0
    this.#render()
  }

  increment() {
    this.#count++
    this.#render()
    this.dispatch("change", { count: this.#count })
  }

  #render() {
    this.target("count").textContent = this.#count
  }
})
ExportDescription
define(name, Class)Registers a controller class for data-NAME roots.
ControllerBase class. Provides this.element, connect(), disconnect(), target(name), targets(name), hasTarget(name), data(key), hasData(key) and dispatch(type, detail). Actions are called with the event and the element that declared the action.
observe(selector, { connect, disconnect })Runs callbacks when elements start or stop matching a selector. Use it for behaviors that need no root.
debounce(fn, wait)A trailing-edge debounce.

When you use the bundle, import from it instead: import { define, Controller } from "…/dist/velle.js".
